title: Leonen to serve as OIC when Gesmundo retires as chief justice
summary: Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen will be acting chief justice when Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo retires in November, court spokesperson Atty. Camille Ting said.
